APTSITES.description: The sites in /etc/apt/sources.list that you wish to mirror.

LOCALDIR.description: The absolute path to your debian directory (top of your local mirror).

PKGTYPE.description: The package types you want to mirror. Possible values: binary, source, both.

FILECACHE.description: The full path to your local cache of package files.

LISTSTATE.description: The full path to your local cache of Packages files.

DELETE.description: Whether apt-move should delete obsolete files from your mirror (yes/no).

MAXDELETE.description: Maximum percentage of files to delete during a normal run.

COPYONLY.description: Whether to keep originals for move/movefile (yes/no).

PKGCOMP.description: Compression for Packages/Sources files. Use 'none gzip' for uncompressed.

GPGKEY.description: Key name to be used for signing Release files.
